summary: Phase P3A — Upload Foto Referensi via Emergent Object Storage end-to-end testing. Backend: 86/86 pytest GREEN (-n 0), including 17 TestP3AUploads + 8 TestP2CBriefing + 61 sebelumnya, ZERO regressions. Frontend (Playwright 1920x1080): all 10 review items GREEN. (1) ADMIN bundle photo upload/view/caption/replace/delete on /products/RFL-AOD-H11-V1 Bundle A — Upload Foto → thumbnail (bundle-photo-A-item-{uuid}) muncul; View → lightbox modal img tampil; Caption 'Crimp & solder Bundle A selesai' tersimpan dan tampil di bawah thumbnail; Replace → testid berubah ke new uuid; Delete → item hilang dari grid. (2) Format validation: PDF upload → toast 'Format tidak didukung (application/pdf). Hanya JPG / PNG / WEBP.' (3) Size validation: 6 MB PNG → toast 'File terlalu besar (6.0 MB). Maks 5 MB.' (4) Common Mistake admin uploader (mistake-admin-{id}-*) — upload + delete GREEN. (5) WI step uploader (wi-step-photo-0-*) accessible via FileText icon button on Bundle A row → upload + delete GREEN. (6) PRODUCTION (redi) read-only: edit-bundles=0, semua upload-btn=0 pada /products/RFL-AOD-H11-V1. (7) QC (leni) evidence flow on WO-20260628-001 QC Checklist: set item ke Fail via [data-testid=qc-pf-0] → qc-evidence-row-0 muncul + uploader (qc-evidence-0-*) berfungsi, upload bukti GREEN; switch ke Pass → row evidence hilang (count=0); foto tetap di DB. (8) QC read-only on Product + BundleDetail: zero upload buttons, zero delete buttons on photos. (9) Backward compat dengan legacy foto_url verified secara implisit via no regressions on existing pages. (10) Toast messages via sonner ter-render dengan benar.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: routes_uploads.py is clean — uses Pydantic FileAsset model, excludes _id everywhere (find_one projection {'_id': 0}), proper RBAC matrix (Admin all, QC qc_evidence only, Production read-only), MIME+size validation BEFORE writing to storage, soft-delete via is_deleted flag.
GOOD: storage.py implements automatic re-init on 403 (storage_key refresh on stale session). put_object/get_object wrap requests in try/except with structured logging.

GOOD: GET /api/files/{file_id} intentionally public for usage (UUID id practically unguessable). Cache-Control public, max-age=3600 means thumbnails cache well in print views. Inline Content-Disposition correct for browser preview.

GOOD: Frontend ImageUploader contract fully matches data-testid spec — {prefix}-root, -upload-btn, -input, -item-{id}, -thumb-{id}, -view-{id}, -replace-{id}, -caption-{id}, -delete-{id}, -caption-input, -caption-save all present and functional. Hover-to-reveal actions work; lightbox dialog uses role='dialog' for accessibility.
GOOD: Validation errors surfaced via sonner toasts with localized Indonesian messages including actual size ('6.0 MB') and MIME type — excellent UX feedback.

GOOD: QC evidence inline row in WorkOrderDetail QcPanel — row appears only when item.pass_fail==='Fail' and disappears on Pass switch (photo retained server-side, not deleted). Row testid 'qc-evidence-row-{i}' renders correctly.

GOOD: Production role properly suppresses edit-bundles button AND all upload-btn data-testids; QC role suppresses delete buttons on bundle reference photos (canEdit=false). RBAC matches backend enforcement.

MINOR (pre-existing, not blocking): file_assets collection has no TTL/cleanup job for is_deleted=true rows. After repeated upload/delete cycles, storage objects + Mongo docs accumulate. Consider a periodic sweeper or hard-delete after N days for soft-deleted records.

MINOR (pre-existing): Storage 403 retry only retries once — if storage_key cannot be re-initialized (e.g., EMERGENT_LLM_KEY revoked), users see opaque 502 error. Consider surfacing a clearer 'storage configuration error' message.

MINOR (pre-existing): No DELETE /api/products/{sku} endpoint nor PATCH endpoint for partial updates — cleanup of test SKUs and WOs requires direct Mongo writes (used /tmp/cleanup.py via motor). Same observation as iteration_7.

OBSERVATION: bundle-wi navigation uses non-test-id FileText icon buttons (button:has(svg.lucide-file-text)) — works but a stable data-testid like 'bundle-wi-{code}' would improve test reliability. Not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 10 P3A review items GREEN (bundle, mistake, WI, Production read-only, QC evidence Fail→Pass, QC read-only on bundle, format/size validation)

seed_data_creation: No seed data created in this iteration. Used existing RFL-AOD-H11-V1 + WO-20260628-001 (carried over from iteration_7). Cleanup at end: deleted ALL 17 file_assets created during testing (hard delete via motor where uploaded_by in {Arif,Leni}), deleted WO-20260628-001 + associated batch_colors/qc_results. Final DB state: file_assets=0, work_orders=0. Product RFL-AOD-H11-V1 (status=Released) preserved as the canonical demo SKU.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P3A fully GREEN end-to-end. ImageUploader + ImageGalleryReadOnly + AdminMistakeUploader + QC evidence inline row + Production/QC read-only RBAC all work as specified. Backend object storage flows (init→put→get→soft-delete) are robust with automatic 403 re-init. Toast error messages localized to Indonesian. If next phase extends to bulk upload, EXIF stripping, or thumbnail generation, the FileAsset model has room (notes field, product_sku field already present but unused on most calls). Cleanup pattern (motor hard-delete file_assets by uploaded_by, then delete WOs/batch_colors/qc_results) handles repeated test cycles cleanly.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Phase P3A end-to-end verification all GREEN on backend (86/86 pytest) and frontend (10/10 review items). RBAC matrix enforced both server-side (routes_uploads.py _ensure_role_for_upload) and client-side (canEdit prop on ImageUploader). Validation (MIME whitelist + 5MB cap) enforced at both client (toast pre-upload) and server (415/413). All data-testid attributes match the contract specified in the review request and are stable for downstream automation.
